title: 怎样厘清角色、重叠职责和待认领任务
topic: 怎样厘清角色、重叠职责和待认领任务

source.title: How to Define Team Roles and Responsibilities | Atlassian
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 来源是 Atlassian Team Playbook 的 Roles and Responsibilities Play。本课展示 Instructions 的完整流程，练习中出现的人物、任务和日期为模拟场景，不代表 Atlassian 员工或真实项目。
paragraphs: Whether you meet in person or remotely, send a message to the team explaining the Play to ensure that everyone understands what work you will be discussing. At the start of the Play, review the team's mission to set context for what the overall team is responsible for. Next, prep the collaboration document the team will use. You can create a table on a Confluence page or use our ready-to-use template. If you’re creating your own document, add the following columns:
Responsibilities (what others think)
Responsibilities (what I think)
Unassigned responsibilities
Have more than 4 people? Set aside 90 minutes for groups of 6-8.
For groups of 9 or more, break the Play into smaller 1-hour sessions.

Define the various roles within your team and write your role on this project under your name in the “Roles” column. If there are multiple team members occupying the same role, include the role only once in the table. Some team members may have multiple roles, such as a software engineer who also serves as a project manager. In such instances, it is advisable to include each role in the table.
Ask each individual to identify their top 3-5 responsibilities for this project in the “Responsibilities (what I think)” column.
Keep the session focused on roles, not people.
By focusing on the role, the team can identify gaps in what skills are needed to succeed in that role regardless of the people on the team.

For each of the other roles identified, write down your understanding of the role’s top responsibilities in the “Responsibilities (what others think)” column. If you think of any responsibilities that don't fall clearly within a role, add them to the section for unassigned responsibilities.
Review what others have written about your role in the “Responsibilities (what others' think)” column. Add a ✅ if you accept or ❌ if you don’t accept against each responsibility.
Add inline comments if you have questions or comments about others' responsibilities.

Following a team discussion, the role holder reviews all the ❌ and decides whether to assume or delegate additional duties. In cases of task overlap, a primary owner is designated, along with potential contributors or backup owners.

Any responsibilities that remain unclaimed or unaccepted are relocated to the unassigned section. Depending on the organizational structure, the role holder may need approval from their leadership to finalize their role as outlined in this process.

Reviewing unassigned items collectively to determine if these items align with any existing roles and why they may or may not be suitable for specific roles. If these items do not correspond to any role, it indicates the necessity for a new role or a redefinition of an existing one. It is important to designate a responsible individual to identify the owner of these tasks and set a follow-up date. Look out for responsibilities that no role is willing to undertake. If such instances are identified, bring them to the group’s attention for further discussion.
If the team can’t agree on some of the roles or responsibilities, note them as follow-up items to work through in smaller meetings later.

Upon completion, summarize the roles and responsibilities to ensure team alignment. Designate specific individuals to take ownership of each role, and update the shared document with the agreed-upon roles and responsibilities.
Distribute the roles and responsibilities document to key stakeholders and leaders, informing the team about this action.
Plan to review this Play with the team every three or six months, or whenever there are significant changes within the team. Regular practice will make this process smoother.
translations: 无论线下还是远程开展，都要先向团队说明这项活动，确保大家知道要讨论什么。开始时回顾团队使命，为团队整体职责补充背景。然后准备协作文档；可以在 Confluence 页面建表，也可以使用现成模板。若自行建表，请加入以下栏目：
他人认为我负责的事项
我认为自己负责的事项
尚未分配的职责
超过 4 人时，6–8 人的小组应预留 90 分钟。
9 人及以上时，应拆成多场 1 小时的小组活动。
列出团队中的不同角色，并在“角色”栏把自己在本项目中的角色写在姓名下方。同一角色有多人承担时，表中只列一次。一个人也可能承担多个角色，例如软件工程师兼任项目经理，此时应把每个角色都列出来。
请每个人在“我认为自己负责的事项”栏中列出自己在本项目中最重要的 3–5 项职责。
讨论时聚焦角色，而不是具体的人。
聚焦角色有助于团队识别胜任该角色所需技能方面的缺口，不受当前由谁担任该角色的影响。
针对列出的其他角色，写下你认为该角色最重要的职责。如果想到的职责无法明确归属任何角色，就把它放进“尚未分配的职责”栏。
查看他人对你这个角色所写的职责；对每项职责标记 ✅ 表示接受，标记 ❌ 表示不接受。
如果对他人写下的职责有疑问或意见，可以添加行内评论。
团队讨论后，由角色承担者查看所有 ❌ 项，并决定自行承担还是委派额外职责。如果任务有重叠，应指定一位主要负责人，并列出可能的协作者或备份负责人。
仍无人认领或未获接受的职责应移到“尚未分配”栏。根据组织架构，角色承担者可能需要领导批准才能最终确认职责。
团队共同检查未分配事项是否适合归入现有角色。如果不适合，可能需要新增角色或重新定义现有角色。应指定一位负责人来找出这些任务的最终负责人，并设定跟进日期。还要留意没有任何角色愿意承担的职责；发现此类情况，应提出来进一步讨论。
如果团队无法就某些角色或职责达成一致，就把它们记为待跟进事项，之后安排小范围会议处理。
活动结束时，总结角色和职责以确保团队理解一致。为每个角色指定具体负责人，并把商定的职责更新到共享文档中。
把角色与职责文档发给关键利益相关者和负责人，并告知团队已完成这项工作。
每三到六个月，或团队发生重大变化时，与团队重新检查这项流程。定期实践会让流程更顺畅。

notes.explain: Atlassian 建议每个人先列出自己认为最重要的几项职责，再与他人对角色的理解比较。
notes.example: Please list your top three responsibilities for the launch.

notes.explain: 出现职责重叠时，明确一位主要负责人；其他人可以作为协作者或备份，避免“两个人都以为对方会做”。
notes.example: For the client demo, a primary owner is designated, with one backup.

notes.explain: 未认领事项不能只写在清单上；要有人负责继续找出最终负责人，并约定何时回看。
notes.example: Could you set a follow-up date for the open FAQ task?

scenario.title: Agreeing on ownership before a product launch
english: Priya will lead the product demo, and you will prepare the release notes.
The customer FAQ has no owner yet.
You ask a teammate to identify an owner, set a follow-up date, and update the shared document by Wednesday.
chinese: Priya 负责产品演示，你负责准备发布说明。
客户常见问题文档目前还没有负责人。
你请一位同事找出该任务的负责人、设定跟进日期，并在周三前更新共享文档。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟情境：Priya 负责产品演示，你负责发布说明，客户 FAQ 还没有负责人。请用英文说清已确定的分工，提出由同事找出 FAQ 负责人并设定跟进日期，同时要求周三前更新共享文档。
firstAttempt.sample: Priya will own the product demo, and I’ll prepare the release notes. The customer FAQ is still unassigned. Could you take the lead on identifying an owner and setting a follow-up date? Please update the shared document by Wednesday.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先列出已确定的负责人，再指出未认领事项；为“找负责人”这项工作指定执行者，并给出更新期限。

words.example: The customer FAQ is still unassigned.
words.translation: 客户 FAQ 仍未分配负责人。
words.note: 描述尚无负责人或归属的工作。

words.collocation: designate an owner; designate a lead
words.example: We need to designate a primary owner for the demo.
words.translation: 我们需要为演示指定一位主要负责人。
words.note: 比 choose 更正式，常用于明确职责或身份。

words.example: The role holder can delegate the extra review.
words.translation: 该角色负责人可以委派额外的审核工作。
words.note: delegate 是把任务交给他人承担；交出任务后仍可能需要跟进。

words.example: Two people may find that their review tasks overlap.
words.translation: 两个人可能会发现自己的审核任务有重叠。
words.note: 本课中指不同角色承担的任务范围有交叉。

words.example: List contributors alongside the primary owner.
words.translation: 在主要负责人旁边列出协作者。
words.note: 协作者参与任务，但不一定承担最终主要责任。

words.example: Let’s set a follow-up date for the unassigned item.
words.translation: 我们为这项未分配的工作设一个跟进日期。
words.note: 名词或定语用 follow-up；动词短语则写 follow up。

structure.original: Add inline comments if you have questions or comments about others' responsibilities.
analysis: “In cases of task overlap”是条件/情境状语，意思是“遇到任务重叠时”。
主句使用一般现在时被动语态：“a primary owner is designated”强调要指定主要负责人，未强调具体由谁执行指定动作。
“along with”补充说明可同时列出协作者或备份负责人；primary owner 与 backup owner 的责任层级不同。
structure.transfer: For the training session, Mei is the primary owner of the agenda, with Luis as a backup for speaker coordination.

rewrite.bad: We can both handle the customer demo, and someone can sort out the FAQ later.
rewrite.good: Priya will be the primary owner of the demo, with Marco as backup. The FAQ is still unassigned; could you identify an owner and set a follow-up date?
rewrite.translation: Priya 是演示的主要负责人，Marco 负责备份。FAQ 仍未分配；你能找出负责人并设定跟进日期吗？
rewrite.pattern: [Name] will be the primary owner of [task], with [name] as backup. [Other task] is still unassigned; could you identify an owner and set a follow-up date?

cloze.prompt: Each person should list their top ___ responsibilities for the project.
cloze.why: 原文建议每人列出 3–5 项最重要的项目职责。

cloze.prompt: When tasks overlap, designate a ___ owner.
cloze.why: primary owner 是主要负责人；协作者或备份另行列出。

cloze.prompt: Please set a ___ date for reviewing the unassigned item.
cloze.why: follow-up date 是后续检查或推进该事项的日期。

dictation.text: In cases of task overlap, a primary owner is designated, along with potential contributors or backup owners.
It is important to designate a responsible individual to identify the owner of these tasks and set a follow-up date.

translationPractice.answer: Priya will own the product demo.
translationPractice.why: 用 own 表达对一项任务承担主要责任。

translationPractice.prompt: 客户 FAQ 仍然没有负责人。
translationPractice.answer: The customer FAQ is still unassigned.
translationPractice.why: 用 unassigned 明确事项尚未分配。

translationPractice.prompt: 你能负责找出一位负责人并设定跟进日期吗？
translationPractice.answer: Could you take the lead on identifying an owner and setting a follow-up date?
translationPractice.why: 请求某人推进未认领事项，并约定后续时间。

choice.prompt: 设计素材和演示排练都涉及两位同事。按照原文，团队应该怎样处理重叠职责？
options: 指定一位主要负责人，并列出可能的协作者或备份负责人。
让两人都做全部工作，不用确认谁最终负责。
把任务留在未分配清单里，等有人主动接手。
choice.why: 原文明确建议任务重叠时指定 primary owner，并列出潜在协作者或备份负责人。

output.prompt: 模拟迁移：你负责培训场地和材料，Devon 负责讲师安排；无障碍检查尚未分配。请写一段英文，说明已确定的分工，要求同事找出无障碍检查的负责人并设定跟进日期，同时在周四前更新共享文档。
output.sample: I’ll handle the venue and materials, while Devon will coordinate the speakers. The accessibility check is still unassigned. Could you take the lead on identifying an owner and setting a follow-up date? Please update the shared document by Thursday.
check: 是否分别说清楚你和 Devon 已确定的职责？
是否明确指出无障碍检查尚未分配？
是否请具体的人找负责人并设定跟进日期？
是否给出周四前更新共享文档的要求？

taskPhrases.meaning: 明确某项工作的主要负责人
taskPhrases.collocation: own a task; own a deliverable
taskPhrases.example: Priya will own the product demo.

taskPhrases.meaning: 指出某项工作还没有负责人
taskPhrases.example: The customer FAQ is still unassigned.
taskPhrases.translation: 客户 FAQ 仍然没有负责人。

taskPhrases.word: take the lead on identifying an owner and setting a follow-up date
taskPhrases.meaning: 请对方推进找负责人并设定跟进日期
taskPhrases.example: Could you take the lead on identifying an owner and setting a follow-up date?
taskPhrases.translation: 你能负责找出一位负责人并设定跟进日期吗？
